title: Send Command Feedback Fix
description: A lightweight datapack that makes sure the gamerule send_command_feedback is set to true on load.
body:
Have you had issues with not seeing feedback from the carpet mod? Have you had to enable /gamerule send_command_feedback every time you restart your server or join your world? Well no longer. Introducing Send Command Feedback Fix; a very lightweight datapack that enables send_command_feedback apon joining your world or starting your server. 
# Why make this?
I made this because I have been having an issue on my server where send_command_feedback is always off after I restart the server. This is an issue because I mess around with Carpet's settings a lot and I keep not getting feedback when I enter a command. 
## Bug fixing (If any)
If the datapack does not load just type /reload and the load message should appear.
